caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a candlestick holder, presented in two views on a beige or light tan background. The main view is a detailed side elevation, rendered in shades of grey, giving the holder a three-dimensional appearance. The candlestick consists of a central cylindrical section with two outward-flaring rims, a concave middle, and a round base that broadens into a shallow, circular dish or tray. Attached to one side of the tray is a circular handle, depicted as a ring. Below the main drawing, there is a smaller schematic view of the candlestick holder with dimensions labeled, the height indicated as 3 1/8 units and the tray’s diameter as 4 1/4 units, along with the top section measuring 1 5/8 units. A horizontal scale bar, labeled "Scale – 1 in.," and the name “Meyers” are present on the lower left area of the drawing. The composition uses precise lines and shaded areas to convey form, shadow, and detail.
title: Candlestick
